decisions.decision: 8 user waypoints at midpoints between Sony's 9 anchors -> 17-position morph dial
decisions.rationale: Sony anchors stay bit-identical (INTERP-04 preserved); user slots add segment breaks where filled, transparent where empty (fresh project = bit-identical to v1.5).

decisions.decision: Three per-tick action buttons (EDIT, EXPORT, LOAD) stacked top-right of MorphPanel, enabled only when knob parks on a user-slot tick
decisions.rationale: Rejected dropdown approach after long design loop -- ticks are visual-only, dedicated buttons invite the curiosity-driven 'I wonder what these do?' moment. EXPORT additionally requires the slot to be filled. LOAD stamps any single-slot file onto current tick (file's slot index ignored).

decisions.decision: REVERT semantics = 'clear this slot entirely' (not just discard edits)
decisions.rationale: User-requested emergency clear. After REVERT the slot reverts to empty (tick goes dim) and the engine writes the v1.5 transparent-interp Sony state.
Polished launch default sits between hardware-faithful snap and v1.6 full glide.

decisions.decision: user_slots stored per-engine state -- saveUserSlot/clearUserSlot/load mirror to engines[1] (the scratch engine the glide path uses for spu94_interp_set_morph)
decisions.rationale: Without mirroring, the glide path treats every slot as empty, ignoring user saves. Discovered through user testing -- audible bug where saved waypoints sounded generic in Macro view but correct in Advanced.

decisions.decision: All state management (preset drains, morph re-apply, mixer/DAC pushes, shadow syncs) hoisted before the audio-I/O gate
decisions.rationale: Sliders + tick colors must reflect engine state regardless of WAV/playback status. Original processBlock skipped state mgmt when no audio playing.

decisions.decision: Forced re-applies (LOAD, SAVE, REVERT) snap regardless of Morph Speed knob
decisions.rationale: Action buttons need instantaneous feedback, not glide.

decisions.decision: Glide-path morph re-apply syncs shadows from engines[1] (target) instead of engines[0] (mid-slew)
decisions.rationale: Sliders show the destination state, not the in-flight state.

decisions.decision: Custom GritButtonLookAndFeel for Int/Fract toggle (focus-stable saturation)
decisions.rationale: JUCE's LookAndFeel_V4 desaturates buttons without keyboard focus; the Int button rendered as lighter coral until clicked. Override always uses the focused saturation multiplier.

anti_patterns_discovered_this_session.mitigation: user_slots[][] live on the spu94_state struct, so engines[0] and engines[1] each have their own copy. Any operation that mutates user_slots on engines[0] (saveUserSlot, clearUserSlot, per-slot LOAD, full preset LOAD) MUST mirror the change to engines[1] -- otherwise the glide path's spu94_interp_set_morph(engines[1], pos) sees empty slots and produces transparent Sony interp instead of the user's saved values. Audible-but-silent-on-the-snap-path bug; very hard to diagnose without knowing the engine architecture.

anti_patterns_discovered_this_session.pattern: Synchronous spu94_apply_pending_writes from GUI thread mid-frame
anti_patterns_discovered_this_session.mitigation: spu94_apply_pending_writes is documented to be called from EXACTLY ONE location (the first line of spu94_tick). Calling it from the GUI thread or from a different audio-thread point can cause audible blips when engines[0] differs from the just-written morph target. Prefer requesting a re-apply via morphReapplyPending and letting the audio thread handle it through its normal slew/snap path. SAVE flush to apply_pending_writes is the one acknowledged exception (without it, snapshot misses freshly-edited m/d-prefix values).

anti_patterns_discovered_this_session.pattern: Audio I/O gate above state management
anti_patterns_discovered_this_session.mitigation: processBlock's loaded/playing early-return originally skipped morph re-apply, shadow sync, and preset drains when no WAV was loaded. State mgmt MUST run unconditionally so the GUI mirrors engine state at all times. Only the actual sample-read + spu94_process + output-mix loop is gated on loaded/playing.

spu94_snapshot_registers reads only active reg_values[]. m/d-prefix register edits are TICK_LATCHED -- staged into pending_values[] until spu94_tick commits them. Snapshot taken before tick fires misses recent edits. saveUserSlot now flushes pending before snapshot to address this.
